ios.desc:
Unleash your creativity. Describe any edit in plain text and watch our advanced AI bring it to life in seconds. No complex software, no editing skills needed.

Ever wanted to remove an ex from a photo, make a friend smile, or turn your selfie into a Simpsons character, but didn't have the time to learn Photoshop?

Welcome to PromptPic, the revolutionary AI photo editor that puts the power of a professional design studio right in your pocket. If you can type, you can create magic. Our groundbreaking AI understands your words and transforms your photos exactly how you imagine them.

HOW IT WORKS IS AS SIMPLE AS 1-2-3:

Upload a Photo: Choose any image from your gallery or take a new one.

Write a Prompt: Describe the change you want. Be simple ("remove the person in the background") or be bold ("turn my dog into a Lego character").

Create: Tap the button and watch your idea become a reality.

THE ULTIMATE AI EDITOR FOR ANY TASK:

Whether you're looking for a quick fix or a complete artistic transformation, PromptPic is your go-to tool.

Effortless Object Removal & Addition:

"Remove the car from the background"

"Add a birthday hat on his head"

"Clear the beach of all people"

Change Art Styles Instantly:

Become a Minecraft or Lego character.

See yourself in the style of The Simpsons or South Park.

Transform your portrait into a classic Oil Painting, a modern Anime character, or adopt a dark Gothic aesthetic.

Professional-Level Retouching with Simple Words:

"Give me a professional Hollywood glamour look"

"Apply a natural sun tan"

"Fix my hair and remove the flyaways"

Alter Expressions & Moods:

"Make everyone in the photo smile"

"Add tears to my eyes for a dramatic effect"

"Change the lighting to look like a golden sunset"

WHY YOU'LL LOVE PROMPTPIC:

No Skills Required: Finally, an image editor for everyone. Stop watching tutorials and start creating.

Endless Creativity: Your imagination is the only limit. Perfect for creating hilarious memes, unique social media posts, unforgettable gifts, and professional-looking marketing assets.

Save & Share: Instantly save your high-resolution creations to your gallery or share them with friends on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and more.

GET STARTED FOR FREE:

Download PromptPic today and receive 3 FREE tokens to try it out. Each photo creation costs one token. When you're ready for more, you can easily top up your account with our flexible token packs.

Stop dreaming about the perfect photo. Download Pro
